intro_text: With the infection being spread by infected bites, p_l has decided to try and teach some Clanmates how to effectively avoid a bite from a rogue when in a fight.
decline_text: The concept scares the rest of the patrol and p_l decides to save it for another day.

success_outcomes.text: p_l shows r_c how to firmly grab an opponent's head and shove it into the ground to escape. Though this strategy may leave you open for scratches and kicks, a sore Clanmate is better than an infected one.

p_l and r_c demonstrate a technique that involves holding the opponents head away from you with your hind paws and using your forelegs to scratch up their muzzle. The practice session goes great, and p_l feels confident that {PRONOUN/p_l/poss} Clanmates will be able to defend themselves.

fail_outcomes.text: Despite p_l's best efforts, the rest of the patrol is too focussed on deflecting claws than teeth, and they often leave themselves open for a bite. p_l ends the training session to try again later.

intro_text: The patrol is having a hard time focussing on their training as the breeze carries the scent of infection through the clearing.
decline_text: The patrol decides to head back to camp, where they can train in safety.

success_outcomes.text: Being a warrior is all about adapting to your surroundings, even if they're scary! p_l manages to improve the spirits of the patrol enough to get a good few sparring sessions in. Now, these c_n warriors will be ready to face the infection head-on!

How is c_n supposed to defned themselves against the infection if their warriors are too afraid? p_l gives a quick pep talk, tail lashing with passion, and by the end, the cats are pumped up enough to continue their training, regardless of the sickness on the wind.

fail_outcomes.text: p_l tries to start up a sparring session, but fear leaves the rest of the patrol too distracted to participate. Unaccomplished, the patrol heads back to camp.
